None is installed: .git/hooks holds only samples and core.hooksPath is unset. done:9 does not require one, and `node tools/secret_scan.ts --cached` is ready to serve as that hook. (c) The ignored on-disk caches pipeline/__pycache__/meshy_anims.cpython-313.pyc and meshy_chars_img.cpython-313.pyc still hold the literal, as does pre-fix history. Neither is a tracked file at HEAD, and the plan gates any history purge on the owner.
